problem: The retained-evidence preflight previously required safe, distinct, role-routed paths but still allowed filenames that omitted the exact commit and artifact role, weakening provenance and increasing collision or misassociation risk.

contract: Every retained output basename must contain the full 40-character exact commit SHA.
Every retained output basename must contain its designated artifact-role token.
Existing canonicalization, role routing, no-overwrite, repository binding, pagination, and deployment-prohibition checks remain fail-closed.

new_cases: reject output names omitting the exact commit SHA
reject output names omitting or misstating the artifact role

claim_boundary: This proves deterministic preflight classification in the isolated Node runtime and exact-commit source readback.
It does not prove GitHub authentication, exhaustive workflow enumeration, raw-header authenticity, Vercel deployment identity, browser behavior, audio audibility, or physical-device verification.
rollback: Revert commits 78e30175a096c346f159ed9dc1797854d1417e9b and 8a73d3e4c19df60b6de3de6485a4ec945d2f6f26; no deployment state or user data changed.
